title.rendered: I Am Blessed With Every Spiritual Blessing: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: God has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ. Every. Not some. Not most. The believer is not waiting on the blessing. The blessing has already been given.

content.rendered:
Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ. Every. Not some. Not most. Every. The believer is not waiting on the blessing. The blessing has already been given.

The Gospel For Today | Friday, July 3, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.”
Ephesians 1:3 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul opens Ephesians 1 with one of the densest, most theologically loaded sentences in the New Testament. In the original Greek, Ephesians 1:3-14 is a single sentence that runs for over two hundred words. The whole sentence is one long doxology celebrating the blessings God has poured out on the believer in Christ. Verse 3 is the opening line of that doxology. It is the headline. Every spiritual blessing.

The Greek word for “every” is pasēs. It is exhaustive. It leaves nothing out. Every blessing the Father has to give His Son, He has placed on the believer in Christ. Wisdom. Revelation. Sonship. Redemption. Forgiveness. Inheritance. Sealing. Hope. Future. Every category of spiritual provision the believer could ever need is already on deposit, waiting to be drawn on by faith.

The mistake most believers make is to read this verse as a promise of future blessing rather than as a statement of present possession. They pray “Lord, please bless me” as if the blessing has not been given yet. Paul says the blessing has been given. Every one of them. In Christ. Already. The work of the believer is not to talk God into blessing them. The work of the believer is to walk in the blessing that has already been placed in their account.

Practically, this changes how prayer functions. The believer who knows they have already been blessed with every spiritual blessing does not pray as a beggar. They pray as a child accessing an inheritance. When they need wisdom, they do not ask God to consider giving it. They thank God for the wisdom already deposited in them through the indwelling Spirit and ask for that wisdom to come forward in the situation in front of them. When they need provision, they do not plead. They acknowledge what is theirs in Christ and walk in it. This is not presumption. It is faith built on the finished work of the cross.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth is the same today. The blessing you are looking for tomorrow has already been given to you today, in Christ. Open your hands. Receive what the Father has placed in your account. Every spiritual blessing is yours in Him. Walk in it.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that I am blessed with every spiritual blessing in Christ. I do not approach You as a beggar. I come to You as a child accessing an inheritance that is already mine. Every blessing You have for me has been placed on deposit in Christ. I receive it today. The wisdom, the favour, the provision, the strength, the revelation, the peace, the joy. All of it is mine in Him. I walk in this blessing today, hands open, heart grateful. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I am blessed with every spiritual blessing in Christ in the heavenly realms. The blessing has already been given. I walk in it today.

Go Deeper in the Word

  • 2 Peter 1:3: His divine power has given us everything we need
  • Romans 8:32: How will He not also graciously give us all things?
